title: Test Data Management for API Testing

scenes.line1: How do you keep API tests reliable?
scenes.say: How do you keep your API tests reliable every single run? What about the data you use?

scenes.label: Isolate
scenes.sub: Create and clean test data for every run.
scenes.say: First, always create and clean your test data for every run. This keeps each test isolated and repeatable.
Fixtures let you seed your database and reset data before tests. Mocks simulate endpoints, so you skip real external calls. Both make your tests reliable.

scenes.title: Mocking a payments endpoint
scenes.say: Here's an example. Start a mock server to simulate your payments endpoint. Now your tests won't break if the real service changes.

scenes.question: What makes an API test flaky?
scenes.right: Tests that depend on shared or changing data can fail randomly. Always isolate your test data.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: What makes an API test flaky? Using real, shared data. Always isolate your test data to avoid random failures.
